message.content: This is the final review round. Claims c1 and c2 are confirmed with decisive in-scope evidence: the direct `sqrt(1+x*x)-1` FP32 form causes tolerance violations across the small-to-mid |x| band (worst err/tol 9.51 at x≈0.0447), including snap-to-zero behavior below 0.011. The 50 violations found just above the 0.11 cutoff in the c3 probe are the same cancellation mechanism already covered by c1. Extrema and subnormals are clean, so no additional failure mode exists. No new material claims are needed.
